register.p: Then register it in Antigravity CLI's global MCP file, ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json (Windows: %USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\mcp_config.json). Merge this into the file, keeping every server already there. Create the file and its folder if they don't exist. If a {{SERVER}} entry already exists (the first launch of agy and agy plugin import gemini can carry one over from Gemini CLI), ask the user before replacing it.
{{ABS_NOTE}} {{WIN_ABS_NOTE}} timeoutSeconds matters: {{SHORT}} answers can take a while, and the default limit for one tool call is 180 seconds.

confirm.p: It should show {{SERVER}} under mcpServers and still be valid JSON. Then ask the user to type /mcp in Antigravity CLI and reload, or start a new agy session. {{SERVER}} should show as active with its tools.
